guide.intro: Don’t have the file yet? Download your own 2-year meter report from IEC. It’s a quick, secure, self-service flow — this app can’t log in for you (it has no server and never handles your IEC credentials), but here’s exactly how to get it:
guide.tip1: The page opens on the “תמונות מצב” (Snapshots) tab, which has no export — switch to the “לפי תקופה” (By period) tab.
guide.tip2: The export link is tiny, at the very bottom: tap “למייל שלך” in the “שליחת קובץ אקסל…” line to email yourself the file.
guide.step1Label: Open the IEC personal area and log in
guide.step1Detail: Use the button above — it opens the official IEC site in a new tab. Sign in with your ID / customer number + the SMS code. This app never sees your credentials. If you have several meters, pick the electricity one.
guide.step2Label: Go to “נתוני הצריכה שלך” → “מצב צריכה עדכני”
guide.step2Detail: From your personal area open “Your consumption data” (נתוני הצריכה שלך), then “Current consumption status” (מצב צריכה עדכני).
guide.step3Label: Switch to the “לפי תקופה” (By period) tab
guide.step3Detail: ⚠️ The page opens on the “תמונות מצב” (Snapshots) tab, which has NO export. Tap the other tab — “לפי תקופה” (By period) — to reveal the export option.
guide.step4Label: Scroll to the bottom and tap “למייל שלך”
guide.step4Detail: ⚠️ At the very bottom there’s a small line: “שליחת קובץ אקסל עם נתוני צריכה מהשנתיים האחרונים למייל שלך” (send an Excel file with the last two years of consumption to your email). Tap the “למייל שלך” link — it’s easy to miss.
guide.step5Label: Open the email from IEC and save the file
guide.step5Detail: IEC emails you the file (up to ~2 years of 15-minute data). Save the attachment — it looks like meter_LP_…csv (or .xlsx).
guide.step5Note: It usually arrives within a few minutes — IEC officially says it can take up to a few hours, so don’t worry if it isn’t instant (check your spam folder too).
guide.step6Detail: Drop the file onto the box above, or use “Choose file”. Everything is parsed locally in your browser — nothing is uploaded anywhere.
